# TDPdf v1.29.1.0

**The cross-window tab drag feature from 1.29.0.0 now reports its failures, instead of some of them disappearing silently.**

1.29.0.0 shipped drag-and-drop tab moves between TDPdf windows without any telemetry behind it. That meant a pipe timeout, a target window declining an import, a new window failing to spawn, or an unhandled exception in the handoff would each surface as, at best, a status line the user would likely never notice — and at worst, nothing at all.

This release adds:

- Lifecycle events for starting a drag and dropping it back on the same window.
- A recorded reason whenever a move is refused (an unsaved untitled document, a declined save prompt, a save failure).
- Timed success/failure tracking for the window-to-window transfer, the tear-off-to-new-window path, and the receiving side of an import — the same shape every other timed operation in the app already uses.
- Sanitized crash records for the exception paths that were previously silent.

No behavior changes — this is purely instrumentation around the feature that shipped in 1.29.0.0.
